name: custom-llm-provider
displayName: Custom LLM Provider for Copilot Chat
description: Custom LLM provider that auto-fetches models from OpenAI-compatible endpoints

endpoint.title: Endpoint URL
endpoint.description: Enter the base URL of your OpenAI-compatible API (e.g., http://localhost:11434 or http://localhost:20128)

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Enter your API key for authentication (leave empty if not required)

customLlmProvider.enabled.description: Enable or disable the entire Custom LLM Provider. When disabled, no models are registered.

customLlmProvider.endpoint.description: Base URL of your OpenAI-compatible API endpoint (without /v1)

customLlmProvider.apiKey.description: API key for authentication (leave empty if not required)

customLlmProvider.autoRefreshInterval.description: Auto-refresh models interval in minutes (0 = disabled)

customLlmProvider.additionalModels.description: Additional model IDs to register that may not appear in /v1/models

customLlmProvider.includeModels.description: If not empty, only models with these IDs (or matching these patterns) will be registered.

customLlmProvider.excludeModels.description: Models with these IDs (or matching these patterns) will be ignored.

customLlmProvider.maxInputTokens.description: Default maximum input token context window for all models.

customLlmProvider.maxOutputTokens.description: Default maximum output tokens per response for all models.

customLlmProvider.defaultTemperature.description: Default temperature for sampling (0-2). Applied to all models unless overridden.

customLlmProvider.defaultTopP.description: Default top-p for nucleus sampling (0-1). Applied to all models unless overridden.

customLlmProvider.streamTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each streaming request (0 = no timeout).

customLlmProvider.modelAliases.description: Model aliases: key = alias name, value = target model ID. Aliases appear alongside real models.

customLlmProvider.proxyUrl.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080). Leave empty for direct connection.

customLlmProvider.requestDelay.description: Default delay between requests in milliseconds for all models.

customLlmProvider.toolCalling.description: Default: whether models support tool/function calling.

customLlmProvider.toolFlavor.description: Format for tool calling. Use 'text-based' for smaller local models.

customLlmProvider.vision.description: Default: whether models support image/vision input.

customLlmProvider.thinking.description: Default: whether models support extended thinking.

customLlmProvider.reasoningEffort.description: Default reasoning effort level for all models.

customLlmProvider.modelOverrides.description: Per-model capability overrides. Keys are model IDs, values are partial modelFallbackConfigs.

customLlmProvider.maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed API requests (0 = disabled).

customLlmProvider.retryDelay.description: Base delay in milliseconds between retry attempts.

customLlmProvider.retryOnStatus.description: HTTP status codes that trigger a retry.

customLlmProvider.additionalEndpoints.description: Additional OpenAI-compatible endpoints with unique model prefixes.

id.description: Unique identifier for this endpoint, used as prefix for its models (e.g. 'ollama')

enabled.description: Enable or disable this specific endpoint.

url.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API (without /v1, e.g. http://localhost:11434)

includeModels.description: Optional list of model IDs or wildcard patterns to include.

excludeModels.description: Optional list of model IDs or wildcard patterns to exclude.

additionalModels.description: Additional model IDs to register that may not appear in /v1/models.

modelOverrides.description: Per-model capability overrides for this endpoint.

customLlmProvider.inlineCompletion.enabl.description: Enable inline code completion (auto-complete) using custom LLM provider.

customLlmProvider.inlineCompletion.endpo.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API for inline completion (falls back to primary endpoint if empty).

customLlmProvider.inlineCompletion.apiKe.description: API key for inline completion (falls back to primary apiKey if empty).

customLlmProvider.inlineCompletion.model.description: Model ID to use for inline completion (e.g., 'meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct' on OpenRouter, or 'qwen2.5-coder' on Ollama). Required.

customLlmProvider.inlineCompletion.mode.description: Completion mode: 'chat-fim' (Instruct-based Fill-in-the-Middle), 'completions-fim' (raw /v1/completions FIM), or 'forward-only' (chat continuation).

customLlmProvider.inlineCompletion.debou.description: Delay in milliseconds to wait before triggering API requests after user stops typing.

customLlmProvider.inlineCompletion.maxCo.description: Maximum number of lines around the cursor (before and after) to send as context.

customLlmProvider.inlineCompletion.useSt.description: Enable or disable streaming mode for inline completion. Set to false if your endpoint does not support SSE streaming for completions.

customLlmProvider.inlineCompletion.timeo.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for an inline completion response before aborting the request.
